records.context: A port of ``simple_categorize`` from the Broad pooled Cell Painting profiling recipe (:data:`RECIPE_SIMPLE_SOURCE`), which assigned PERISCOPE's per-cell ``Perfect`` and ``Great`` classes. The spots of a cell are grouped by gene and barcode, each group's mean score and spot count are taken, and then: one barcode with a mean score of exactly 1 is ``perfect`` and below 1 is ``great``; with several barcodes, one barcode holding both the single highest mean score and the single highest count is ``imperfect``, anything else is ``bad``. Spots with a missing gene or barcode are left out, as the recipe's group-by leaves them out.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix.recipe_simple_quality#1
records.source: A port of ``simple_categorize`` from the Broad pooled Cell Painting profiling recipe (:data:`RECIPE_SIMPLE_SOURCE`), which assigned PERISCOPE's per-cell ``Perfect`` and ``Great`` classes. The spots of a cell are grouped by gene and barcode, each group's mean score and spot count are taken, and then: one barcode with a mean score of exactly 1 is ``perfect`` and below 1 is ``great``; with several barcodes, one barcode holding both the single highest mean score and the single highest count is ``imperfect``, anything else is ``bad``. Spots with a missing gene or barcode are left out, as the recipe's group-by leaves them out.
records.translation: En portering av ``simple_categorize`` från Broads recept för profilering av poolad Cell Painting (:data:`RECIPE_SIMPLE_SOURCE`), som tilldelade PERISCOPE:s klasser ``Perfect`` och ``Great`` per cell. En cells fläckar grupperas efter gen och streckkod, varje grupps medelpoäng och antal fläckar tas fram, och sedan gäller: en streckkod med en medelpoäng på exakt 1 är ``perfect`` och under 1 ``great``; med flera streckkoder blir det ``imperfect`` om en streckkod har både den enda högsta medelpoängen och det enda högsta antalet, annars ``bad``. Fläckar utan gen eller streckkod utelämnas, på samma sätt som receptets gruppering utelämnar dem.
